mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation_messages (channel_binding_id, idempotency_key, external_message_id, role, content, content_hash, delivery_status) VALUES (#{channelBindingId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{externalMessageId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{contentHash}, #{deliveryStatus}) ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) WHERE role = 'USER' DO NOTHING
